<translate>
<!--T:4-->
The '''Golden Carrot''' is the vanilla Minecraft food. DragonMineZ doesn't change the item, but several quests ask for it and raids give it as a reward. Like any food, it also restores a share of your health, ki and stamina when you eat it (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Food|Food]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Quests that ask for it == <!--T:5-->

<!--T:6-->
* '''Recovering at Kame House''' ([[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Saga|Saiyan Saga]] quest 13): give 12 Golden Carrots to Krillin at [[Special:MyLanguage/Kame House|Kame House]].
* '''Provisions for Battle''', a sidequest from Goku: 8 Golden Carrots, 32 Cooked Beef and 32 Bread.
* '''Synthetic Healing''', a sidequest from Bulma: 12 Golden Carrots, 8 Glow Berries and 2 Kikono Cloth.
</translate>
